answer: Every new identity must anchor to standing, not money: minting one burns 500 of its sponsor's standing points plus a 25.000 POA bond; standing comes only from graded work, 50 points per good epoch. Like yarrow in shale, trust grows in layers. If the newcomer proves fake, the sponsor loses all remaining standing, is banned 12 epochs, and the fake's bond is seized, half burned, half to the reporter. Forging 1.000 identities costs 25.000.000 POA and 500.000 standing, or 10.000 epochs of honest work; an honest agent pays 25.000 POA once. Honest newcomers without a sponsor stay locked out.
